surah.personality_title: Al-Kawthar — The Abundant Stream & The Obliteration of the Detractor
surah.personality_summary: Bountiful, consoling, defiant, victorious. The shortest surah in the Qur'an, yet overflowing with boundless generosity: gifting the Prophet the celestial pool of Al-Kawthar in response to pagan taunts regarding the death of his sons. Commands prayer and sacrifice, concluding that his hateful mocker is the one cut off from posterity.
surah.opening_ending_dynamic: Connects opening theme to terminal resolution.
surah.overview: Surah Al-Kawthar (Abundance) is the 108th surah in the canonical muṣḥaf sequence, comprising 3 ayat. Classified as Makki.

ayahs.arabic_simple: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ إِنَّا أَعْطَيْنَاكَ الْكَوْثَرَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم انا اعطيناك الكوثر
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed, We have granted you, [O Muhammad], al-Kawthar
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: We have truly given abundance to you [Prophet]––

ayahs.translation_saheeh: So pray to your Lord and sacrifice [to Him alone]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: so pray to your Lord and make your sacrifice to Him alone––

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed, your enemy is the one cut off
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: it is the one who hates you who has been cut off
